units.zh: 卷三 梁本纪第三
units.en: Volume 3: Later Liang Annals 3.
units.literal: Volume Three — Basic Annals of Liang, Part Three.

units.zh: 末帝，太祖第三子友贞也。
units.en: The Last Emperor was Zhu Youzhen, Taizu’s third son.
units.literal: The Last Emperor was Youzhen, the third son of Taizu.

units.zh: 「末」非謚號，從其本語。
units.en: “Mo,” or “last,” is not a posthumous title; the text simply follows the original wording.
units.literal: “Mo” is not a posthumous title; the text follows the original wording.

units.zh: 为人美容貌，沈厚寡言，雅好儒士。
units.en: He was handsome, reserved and taciturn, and had long cultivated the company of scholars.
units.literal: By nature he had a handsome countenance; he was deep, steady, and sparing of words, and from of old he favored Confucian scholars.

units.zh: 太祖即位，封均王，为左天兴军使、东京马步军都指挥使。
units.en: After Taizu became emperor he made Youzhen Prince of Jun and named him commissioner of the Left Heavenly Revival Army and commander of all horse and foot troops at the eastern capital.
units.literal: When Taizu took the throne, he enfeoffed him Prince of Jun, and appointed him commissioner of the Left Heavenly Revival Army and overall commander of the eastern-capital horse and foot forces.

units.zh: 乾化二年六月，太祖遇弑，友珪自立，杀博王友文，以弑帝之罪归之。
units.en: In the sixth month of Qianhua 2 (912) Taizu was murdered. Yougui seized the throne, executed Prince of Bo Zhu Youwen, and blamed him for the assassination.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Qianhua, Taizu was assassinated; Yougui seized power himself, killed Prince of Bo Youwen, and laid the crime of regicide upon him.

units.zh: 以王为东京留守、开封尹，敬翔为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章事，户部尚书李振为崇政院使。
units.en: Youzhen was appointed eastern-capital regent and Kaifeng prefect; Jing Xiang became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor; and Minister of Revenue Li Zhen became commissioner of the Court of Esteemed Governance.
units.literal: Youzhen was made eastern-capital regent and prefect of Kaifeng; Jing Xiang was made vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor; and Li Zhen, minister of revenue, was made commissioner of the Court of Esteemed Governance.

units.zh: 明年，友珪改元曰凤历。
units.en: The following year Yougui adopted the reign title Fengli.
units.literal: The next year Yougui changed the era name to Fengli.

units.zh: 二月，驸马都尉赵岩至东都，王私与之谋，遣马慎交之魏州，见杨师厚计事。
units.en: In the second month Imperial Son-in-law Commander Zhao Yan came to the eastern capital. Youzhen conferred with him in secret and sent Ma Shenjiao to Weizhou to win Yang Shihou to their cause.
units.literal: In the second month, Imperial Son-in-law Commander Zhao Yan arrived at the eastern capital; Youzhen met with him in private to plot, and sent Ma Shenjiao to Weizhou to consult Yang Shihou.

units.zh: 师厚遣小校王舜贤至洛阳，告左龙虎统军袁象先使讨贼。
units.en: Shihou dispatched a junior officer, Wang Shunxian, to Luoyang with orders for Yuan Xiangxian, commander of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army, to march against the usurper.
units.literal: Shihou sent a junior officer, Wang Shunxian, to Luoyang to tell Yuan Xiangxian, commander of the Left Dragon-Tiger Army, to raise troops against the usurper.

units.zh: 是时怀州龙骧屯兵叛，方捕索之，王乃伪为友珪诏书，发左右龙骧在东都者皆还洛阳，因激怒之曰：「天子以怀州屯兵叛，追汝等欲尽坑之。」
units.en: Meanwhile the Longxiang garrison at Huaizhou had mutinied and was being rounded up. Youzhen forged an edict in Yougui’s name recalling every Longxiang unit at the eastern capital to Luoyang, then told them: “The emperor, citing the mutiny at Huaizhou, is hunting you down to slaughter you to the last man.”
units.literal: At that time the Longxiang garrison at Huaizhou had rebelled and was being hunted down; Youzhen then forged an edict in Yougui’s name ordering all Longxiang troops stationed at the eastern capital to return to Luoyang, and incited them, saying: “Because the Huaizhou garrison rebelled, the Son of Heaven is pursuing you and intends to bury you all alive.”

units.zh: 诸将皆泣，莫知所为。
units.en: The officers broke down in tears, utterly at a loss.
units.literal: The generals all wept and knew not what to do.

units.zh: 王曰：「先皇帝经营王业三十餘年，今日尚为友珪所杀，汝等安所逃死乎！」
units.en: Youzhen said: “The late emperor spent more than thirty years building this dynasty, and Yougui has just murdered him. Where can any of you hope to live?”
units.literal: Youzhen said: “The late emperor built up the royal enterprise for more than thirty years, and today he was still murdered by Yougui — where can you flee to escape death!”

units.zh: 因出太祖画像示诸将而泣曰：「汝能趋洛阳擒逆贼，则转祸为福矣。」
units.en: He brought out Taizu’s portrait, wept before the troops, and said: “March on Luoyang, capture the usurper, and you will turn ruin into reward.”
units.literal: He then produced Taizu’s portrait, showed it to the generals, and wept, saying: “If you can hurry to Luoyang and seize the rebel, you will turn disaster into blessing.”

units.zh: 军士皆呼万岁，请王为主，王乃遣人趣象先等。
units.en: The men shouted their allegiance and begged Youzhen to lead them. He sent word urging Yuan Xiangxian and his allies to act.
units.literal: The soldiers all shouted “Long live the Son of Heaven!” and asked that Youzhen be their leader; he then sent men to urge on Xiangxian and the others.

units.zh: 庚寅，象先等以禁兵讨贼，友珪死，杜晓见杀。
units.en: On the day gengyin Yuan Xiangxian led the palace guard against the usurper. Yougui was killed, and Du Xiao died with him.
units.literal: On the day gengyin, Xiangxian and the others led the palace troops against the usurper; Yougui died, and Du Xiao was killed.

units.zh: 象先遣赵岩持传国宝至东都，请王入洛阳，王报曰：「夷门，太祖所以兴王业也，北拒并汾，东至淮海，国家藩镇，多在东方，命将出师，利于便近。」
units.en: Xiangxian sent Zhao Yan with the imperial seal to the eastern capital, inviting Youzhen to Luoyang. He answered: “Yimen is where Taizu founded the dynasty. It commands the north against Bing and Fen and the Huai and sea in the east. Most of our provinces lie eastward, and campaigns are easier when the court stays near the front.”
units.literal: Xiangxian sent Zhao Yan with the imperial seal to the eastern capital, asking Youzhen to enter Luoyang; Youzhen replied: “Yimen is where Taizu raised the royal enterprise — it faces Bing and Fen in the north and reaches to the Huai and sea in the east. Most of the realm’s military governors lie in the east; when generals take the field, proximity is an advantage.”

units.zh: 是月，皇帝即位於東都，即位大事，失其日而書「是月」，見亂之甚。
units.en: That month the emperor was enthroned at the Eastern Capital. Enthronement is a major event, and the loss of the exact day, leaving only “that month,” shows how severe the disorder was.
units.literal: That month, the emperor took the throne at the Eastern Capital; enthronement is a great matter, and losing its day and writing “that month” shows the extremity of the disorder.

units.zh: 「於東都」，終上文也。
units.en: The phrase “at the Eastern Capital” closes out the preceding passage.
units.literal: “At the Eastern Capital” completes the preceding text.

units.zh: 復稱乾化三年，復博王友文官爵。
units.en: He restored the reign title Qianhua 3 and restored the offices and titles of Youwen, Prince of Bo.
units.literal: He again called it the third year of Qianhua, and restored the offices and titles of Youwen, Prince of Bo.

units.zh: 三月丁未，更名鍠。
units.en: On dingwei in the third month, he changed his name to Huang.
units.literal: In the third month, on dingwei, he changed his name to Huang.

units.zh: 夏五月，楊師厚取滄州。
units.en: In the fifth month of summer, Yang Shihou captured Cangzhou.
units.literal: In summer, in the fifth month, Yang Shihou took Cangzhou.

units.zh: 秋九月甲辰，御史大夫姚洎为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章事。
units.en: In the ninth month of autumn, on the day jiachen, Censor-in-Chief Yao Ji became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.
units.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on the day jiachen, Censor-in-Chief Yao Gui was made vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.

units.zh: 冬十二月，晋人取幽州。
units.en: In the twelfth month of winter Jin forces seized Youzhou.
units.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, the Jin took Youzhou.

units.zh: 四年夏四月丁丑，贬于兢为莱州司马。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the fourth year, on the day dingchou, Yu Jing was demoted to military adjutant of Laizhou.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the fourth year, on the day dingchou, Yu Jing was demoted to military adjutant of Laizhou.

units.zh: 武宁军节度使蒋殷反，天平军节度使牛存节讨之。
units.en: Jiang Yin, military governor of Wuning, rebelled. Niu Cunjie, military governor of Tianping, marched against him.
units.literal: Jiang Yin, military governor of the Wuning army, rebelled; Niu Cunjie, military governor of the Tianping army, campaigned against him.

units.zh: 贞明元年春正月，存节克徐州。
units.en: In the first month of spring, Zhenming 1, Cunjie captured Xuzhou.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Zhenming, Cunjie took Xuzhou.

units.zh: 蔣殷自燔死，故不書伏誅。
units.en: Because Jiang Yin burned himself to death, the text does not say he was executed.
units.literal: Jiang Yin burned himself to death; therefore the text does not write that he was executed.

units.zh: 三月丁卯，赵光逢罢。
units.en: In the third month, on the day dingmao, Zhao Guangfeng was removed from office.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day dingmao, Zhao Guangfeng was dismissed.

units.zh: 平盧軍節度使賀德倫為天雄軍節度使，命官不書，非常而有故則書，此書為天雄軍亂張本。
units.en: He Delun of Pinglu was appointed military governor of Tianxiong. Appointments are normally not recorded, but this one was unusual and consequential, so it is written here to set up the Tianxiong mutiny.
units.literal: He Delun, military governor of Pinglu, was made military governor of Tianxiong; appointments to office are not written, but when they are unusual and have a reason they are written, and this entry lays the groundwork for the Tianxiong mutiny.

units.zh: 分其相、澶、衞州為昭德軍，宣徽使張筠為節度使。
units.en: Xiang, Chan, and Wei prefectures were split off as the Zhaode circuit under Palace Commissioner Zhang Yun.
units.literal: Xiang, Chan, and Wei prefectures were divided off to form the Zhaode army, and Palace Commissioner Zhang Yun was made military governor.

units.zh: 己丑，天雄軍亂，賀德倫叛附于晉。
units.en: On jichou, the Tianxiong army mutinied, and He Delun defected to Jin.
units.literal: On jichou, the Tianxiong army mutinied, and He Delun rebelled and attached himself to Jin.

units.zh: 軍亂書，首惡不書而書德倫叛，責貴者深也。
units.en: The text records the mutiny but not its chief culprit, and instead records Delun’s defection, because it assigns heavier blame to the higher-ranking man.
units.literal: The army’s mutiny is written, but the chief culprit is not written, while Delun’s rebellion is written, because blame for the noble is deep.

units.zh: 德倫不可加以首惡，而可責其不死以叛。
units.en: Delun could not be accused as the chief instigator, but he could be blamed for failing to die loyal and instead defecting.
units.literal: Delun cannot be charged as the chief culprit, but he can be blamed for not dying and instead rebelling.

units.zh: 張彥實首惡，而略不書，彥，微者，德倫可以誅而不誅，故以德倫獨任其責。
units.en: Zhang Yan was in fact the chief culprit, but he is omitted because he was a minor figure. Delun could have executed him and failed to do so, so Delun alone is made to bear the blame.
units.literal: Zhang Yan was in fact the chief culprit, but he is omitted and not written; Yan was a minor man, while Delun could have executed him and did not, so Delun alone is made to bear the responsibility.

units.zh: 邠州李保衡叛于岐，来附。
units.en: Li Baoheng of Binzhou broke with Qi and submitted to Liang.
units.literal: Li Baoheng of Binzhou rebelled against Qi and came over to Liang.

units.zh: 夏六月庚寅朔，晋王李存勖入于魏州，遂取德州。
units.en: On the new moon of the sixth month, gengyin, Li Cunxu, Prince of Jin, entered Weizhou and seized Dezhou.
units.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, gengyin, Li Cunxu, Prince of Jin, entered Weizhou and then took Dezhou.

units.zh: 冬十月辛亥，康王友孜反，伏诛。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinhai, Prince of Kang Youzi rebelled and was put to death.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day xinhai, Prince of Kang Youzi rebelled and was executed.

units.zh: 反者不日，誅反者有日，故書。
units.en: A rebellion itself is not dated by day, but the execution of a rebel is, so the date is recorded.
units.literal: For one who rebels, the day is not given; for executing a rebel, there is a day, and therefore it is written.

units.zh: 十一月乙丑，改元。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on the day yichou, the reign title was changed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yichou, the era name was changed.

units.zh: 耀州温昭图叛于岐，来附。
units.en: Wen Zhaotu of Yaozhou broke with Qi and submitted to Liang.
units.literal: Wen Zhaotu of Yaozhou rebelled against Qi and came over to Liang.

units.zh: 是岁，更名瑱。
units.en: That year he adopted the taboo name Zhen.
units.literal: That year he changed his name again to Zhen.

units.zh: 舊史失其月日。
units.en: The old history has lost the month and day.
units.literal: The old history lost its month and day.

units.zh: 二年春二月丙申，杨涉罢。
units.en: In the second month of spring, the second year, on the day bingshen, Yang She was removed from office.
units.literal: In the second month of spring of the second year, on the day bingshen, Yang She was dismissed.

units.zh: 三月，镇南军节度使刘掞及晋人战于故元城，败绩，奔于滑州。
units.en: In the third month Liu Shan, military governor of Zhennan, met Jin forces at Old Yuancheng, was routed, and fled to Huazhou.
units.literal: In the third month, Liu Shan, military governor of the Zhennan army, fought the Jin at Old Yuancheng, was defeated, and fled to Huazhou.

units.zh: 晋人取卫州、惠州。
units.en: Jin forces seized Weizhou and Huizhou.
units.literal: The Jin took Weizhou and Huizhou.

units.zh: 捉生都将李霸反，伏诛。
units.en: Li Ba, commander of the captive-recruitment guard, rebelled and was executed.
units.literal: Li Ba, commander of the captive-recruitment guard, rebelled and was executed.

units.zh: 夏六月，捉生都将张温叛降于晋。
units.en: In the sixth month of summer Zhang Wen, commander of the captive-recruitment guard, defected to the Jin.
units.literal: In summer, the sixth month, Zhang Wen, commander of the captive-recruitment guard, rebelled and surrendered to the Jin.

units.zh: 秋七月，晋人取相州，张筠奔于京师，安国军节度使阎宝叛附于晋。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn the Jin took Xiangzhou. Zhang Yun fled to the capital, and Yan Bao, military governor of Anguo, defected to the Jin.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Jin took Xiangzhou; Zhang Yun fled to the capital; and Yan Bao, military governor of the Anguo army, rebelled and went over to the Jin.

units.zh: 八月丁酉，太子太保致仕赵光逢为司空兼门下侍郎、同中书门下平章事。
units.en: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou, the retired grand guardian of the heir apparent Zhao Guangfeng became minister of works, vice director of the Chancellery, and co-equal grand councilor.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the day dingyou, Zhao Guangfeng, retired grand guardian of the heir apparent, was made minister of works and vice director of the Chancellery, co-equal grand councilor.

units.zh: 九月，晋人取沧州，横海军节度使戴思远奔于京师。
units.en: In the ninth month Jin forces captured Cangzhou. Dai Siyuan, military governor of Henghai, fled to the capital.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Jin took Cangzhou, and Dai Siyuan, military governor of the Henghai army, fled to the capital.

units.zh: 晋人克贝州，守将张源德死之。
units.en: The Jin stormed Beizhou; its defender Zhang Yuande was killed.
units.literal: The Jin took Beizhou, and the defending general Zhang Yuande died in the fighting.

units.zh: 冬十月丁酉，中书侍郎郑珏同中书门下平章事。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingyou, Vice Director of the Secretariat Zheng Jue became co-equal grand councilor.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day dingyou, Vice Director of the Secretariat Zheng Jue was made co-equal grand councilor.

units.zh: 三年夏四月辛卯，右千牛卫大将军刘璩使于契丹。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the third year, on the day xinmao, General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard Liu Zan was dispatched as envoy to the Khitan.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the third year, on the day xinmao, General of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard Liu Zan was sent as envoy to the Khitan.

units.zh: 冬十二月，宣义军节度使贺瑰为北面行营招讨使。
units.en: In the twelfth month of winter He Gui, military governor of Xuanyi, was appointed to command the northern campaign.
units.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, He Gui, military governor of the Xuanyi army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 己巳，如西都卜郊。
units.en: On the day jisi he traveled to the western capital to perform the suburban oracle.
units.literal: On the day jisi he went to the western capital to divine the suburban sacrifice.

units.zh: 晋人取杨刘。
units.en: Jin forces seized Yangliu.
units.literal: The Jin took Yangliu.

units.zh: 四年正月，不克郊，己卯，至自西都。
units.en: In the first month of the fourth year the suburban rites were abandoned. On the day jimao he returned from the western capital.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year he could not complete the suburban sacrifice; on the day jimao he returned from the western capital.

units.zh: 夏四月己酉，尚书吏部侍郎萧顷为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章事。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiyou, Vice Minister of Personnel Xiao Qing became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiyou, Xiao Qing, vice minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was made vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.

units.zh: 己巳，赵光逢罢。
units.en: On the day jisi Zhao Guangfeng was removed from office.
units.literal: On the day jisi Zhao Guangfeng was dismissed.

units.zh: 冬十二月庚子朔，賀瓌殺其將謝彥章、孟審澄、侯溫裕。
units.en: On the gengzi new moon of the twelfth month in winter, He Gui put his generals Xie Yanzhang, Meng Shencheng, and Hou Wenyu to death.
units.literal: In winter, in the twelfth month, on the gengzi new moon, He Gui killed his generals Xie Yanzhang, Meng Shencheng, and Hou Wenyu.

units.zh: 癸亥，瓌及晉人戰于胡柳，敗績。
units.en: On guihai, He Gui fought Jin forces at Huliu and was routed.
units.literal: On guihai, Gui fought the Jin people at Huliu and was defeated.

units.zh: 是歲，泰寧軍節度使張守進叛附于晉，亳州團練使劉鄩為兗州安撫制置使以討之。
units.en: That year Zhang Shoujin of Taining defected to Jin. Liu Xun, training commissioner of Bozhou, was appointed pacification commissioner of Yanzhou to suppress him.
units.literal: That year, Zhang Shoujin, military governor of Taining, rebelled and attached himself to Jin, and Liu Xun, training commissioner of Bozhou, was made pacification and control commissioner of Yanzhou to campaign against him.

units.zh: 舊史不書，亡其月日，故書于歲末，為明年克兗州張本。
units.en: The old history omits the month and day, so the event is placed at year’s end to set up the capture of Yanzhou the next year.
units.literal: The old history does not write it, having lost its month and day; therefore it is written at the end of the year, to lay the groundwork for the capture of Yanzhou in the following year.

units.zh: 五年春正月，晉軍于德勝。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the fifth year, Jin forces encamped at Desheng.
units.literal: In spring, in the first month of the fifth year, Jin camped at Desheng.

units.zh: 用兵無勝敗不書，此梁、晉得失所繫，故書也。
units.en: Military operations without victory or defeat are normally not recorded, but this affected the fortunes of both Liang and Jin, so it is written.
units.literal: In military affairs, matters without victory or defeat are not written; this was where Liang’s and Jin’s gains and losses were tied, and therefore it is written.

units.zh: 秋八月乙未朔，開封尹王瓚為北面行營招討使。
units.en: On the yiwei new moon of the eighth month in autumn, Kaifeng prefect Wang Zan was appointed commander of the northern campaign headquarters.
units.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, on the yiwei new moon, Wang Zan, prefect of Kaifeng, was made commissioner for pacification and campaign of the northern campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 冬十月，劉鄩克兗州，張守進伏誅。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, Liu Xun captured Yanzhou and Zhang Shoujin was put to death.
units.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, Liu Xun took Yanzhou, and Zhang Shoujin was executed.

units.zh: 十二月，晉人取濮陽。
units.en: In the twelfth month, Jin forces seized Puyang.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, the Jin people took Puyang.

units.zh: 天平军节度使霍彦威为北面行营招讨使。
units.en: Huo Yanwei, military governor of Tianping, was appointed to command the northern campaign.
units.literal: Huo Yanwei, military governor of the Tianping army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 六年夏四月己亥，降死罪以下囚。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer in the sixth year, on the day jihai, sentences below death were commuted.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the sixth year, on the day jihai, prisoners below the death penalty were pardoned.

units.zh: 乙巳，尚书左丞李琪为中书侍郎、同中书门下平章事。
units.en: On the day yisi Left Vice Director Li Qi became vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.
units.literal: On the day yisi Li Qi, left vice director of the Secretariat, was made vice director of the Secretariat and co-equal grand councilor.

units.zh: 河中節度使朱友謙襲同州，殺其節度使程全暉，叛附于晉，泰寧軍節度使劉鄩討之。
units.en: Zhu Youqian of Hezhong raided Tongzhou, killed its military governor Cheng Quanhui, and defected to Jin; Liu Xun of Taining marched against him.
units.literal: Zhu Youqian, military governor of Hezhong, raided Tongzhou, killed its military governor Cheng Quanhui, rebelled and attached himself to Jin, and Liu Xun, military governor of Taining, campaigned against him.

units.zh: 秋七月，陳州妖賊毋乙自稱天子。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn, the Chenzhou sorcerer-rebel Wu Yi declared himself emperor.
units.literal: In autumn, in the seventh month, the sorcerous rebel Wu Yi of Chenzhou proclaimed himself Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，供奉官郎公遠為契丹歡好使。
units.en: On gengyin in the ninth month, Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was dispatched as goodwill envoy to the Khitan.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on gengyin, Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was made envoy of cordial relations to the Khitan.

units.zh: 冬十月，毋乙伏誅。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, Wu Yi was put to death.
units.literal: In winter, in the tenth month, Wu Yi was executed.

units.zh: 龍德元年春，趙將張文禮殺其君鎔來乞師，不許。
units.en: In spring of Longde 1, the Zhao general Zhang Wenli murdered his lord Wang Rong and requested military aid; the court refused.
units.literal: In spring of the first year of Longde, the Zhao general Zhang Wenli killed his lord Rong and came to beg for troops; this was not permitted.

units.zh: 文禮初為鎔養子，號王德明，此書張文禮者，從舊史。
units.en: Wenli had first been Wang Rong’s adopted son, under the name Wang Deming. The text calls him Zhang Wenli in accordance with the old history.
units.literal: Wenli had initially been Rong’s adopted son and was called Wang Deming; this writes Zhang Wenli in accordance with the old history.

units.zh: 三月丁亥朔，禁私度僧尼。
units.en: In the third month, on the new moon dinghai, unauthorized ordination of monks and nuns was banned.
units.literal: In the third month, on the first day, dinghai, private ordination of monks and nuns was forbidden.

units.zh: 陳州刺史惠王友能反。
units.en: Prince of Hui Youneng, prefect of Chenzhou, rose in rebellion.
units.literal: Prince of Hui Youneng, prefect of Chenzhou, rebelled.

units.zh: 夏五月丙戌朔，德音改元，降流罪已下囚。
units.en: On the new moon of the fifth month of summer, bingxu, a general amnesty changed the reign title and commuted punishments through exile.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the first day, bingxu, an edict of grace changed the era name and commuted sentences for exiles and below.

units.zh: 秋，赦友能，降封房陵侯。
units.en: That autumn Youneng was pardoned and reduced to Marquis of Fangling.
units.literal: In autumn Youneng was pardoned and demoted to Marquis of Fangling.

units.zh: 天平军节度使戴思远为北面行营招讨使。
units.en: Dai Siyuan of Tianping was appointed to command the northern campaign.
units.literal: Dai Siyuan, military governor of the Tianping army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 冬十月，思远及晋人战于戚城，败绩。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Dai Siyuan met Jin forces at Qicheng and was routed.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Siyuan fought the Jin at Qicheng and was defeated.

units.zh: 二年春正月，思远袭魏州，取成安。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the second year Dai Siyuan raided Weizhou and captured Cheng’an.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, Siyuan raided Weizhou and took Cheng’an.

units.zh: 秋八月，滑州兵马留后段凝攻卫州，执其刺史李存儒。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn Duan Ning, acting commander of the Huazhou garrison, attacked Weizhou and took its prefect Li Cunru prisoner.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Duan Ning, acting commander of the Huazhou forces, attacked Weizhou and captured its prefect Li Cunru.

units.zh: 戴思远克淇门、共城、新乡。
units.en: Dai Siyuan seized Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.
units.literal: Dai Siyuan took Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.

units.zh: 三年春三月，潞州李繼韜叛于晉，來附。
units.en: In the third month of spring in the third year, Li Jitao of Luzhou broke with Jin and submitted to Liang.
units.literal: In spring, in the third month of the third year, Li Jitao of Luzhou rebelled from Jin and came to attach himself.

units.zh: 夏閏四月，唐人取鄆州。
units.en: In the intercalary fourth month of summer, Tang forces captured Yunzhou.
units.literal: In summer, in the intercalary fourth month, the Tang people took Yunzhou.

units.zh: 晉未即位，已自與梁為敵國，至其建號，於梁無所利害，故不書。
units.en: Even before Jin formally enthroned its ruler, it was already an enemy state of Liang; its adoption of a dynastic title did not affect Liang, so that is not recorded.
units.literal: Before Jin had taken the throne, it had already made itself an enemy state to Liang; when it established its title, this had no benefit or harm for Liang, and therefore it is not written.

units.zh: 唐建號而書「唐人」者，因事而見爾。
units.en: The fact that Tang had taken its dynastic name is shown only incidentally here through the phrase “Tang forces.”
units.literal: That Tang had established its title and yet the text writes “Tang people” is merely shown through the event.

units.zh: 五月庚申，宣义军节度使王彦章为北面行营招讨使，取德胜南城。
units.en: In the fifth month, on the day gengshen, Wang Yanzhang of Xuanyi was appointed to command the northern campaign and recovered the southern citadel at Desheng.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengshen, Wang Yanzhang, military governor of the Xuanyi army, was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters and took the southern city of Desheng.

units.zh: 秋八月，段凝为北面行营招讨使。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn Duan Ning was appointed to command the northern campaign.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Duan Ning was made commander-in-chief of the northern-route campaign headquarters.

units.zh: 先锋将康延孝叛降于唐。
units.en: The vanguard commander Kang Yanxiao defected to Tang.
units.literal: The vanguard general Kang Yanxiao rebelled and surrendered to Tang.

units.zh: 冬十月甲戌，宣义军节度使王彦章及唐人战于中都，败绩，死之。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiaxu, Wang Yanzhang of Xuanyi met Tang forces at Zhongdu, was defeated, and was killed.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiaxu, Wang Yanzhang, military governor of the Xuanyi army, fought the Tang at Zhongdu, was defeated, and died.

units.zh: 凡官皆不重書，此書者，嫌彥章已罷招討使而與唐戰，蓋罷使而別將兵以戰也。
units.en: Offices are normally not repeated. It is repeated here lest readers think Yanzhang had already been removed as campaign commander when he fought Tang; apparently he had been dismissed from that commission but separately led troops into battle.
units.literal: In general, offices are not written again; this is written because one might suspect that Yanzhang had already been dismissed as campaign commander and then fought Tang, but he had presumably been dismissed from the commission and separately led troops to fight.

units.zh: 唐人取曹州。
units.en: Tang forces seized Caozhou.
units.literal: The Tang took Caozhou.

units.zh: 盗窃传国宝奔于唐。
units.en: A thief stole the imperial seal and fled to Tang.
units.literal: A thief stole the imperial seal and fled to Tang.

units.zh: 戊寅，皇帝崩。
units.en: On the day wuyin the emperor died.
units.literal: On the day wuyin the emperor died.

units.zh: 年三十六。
units.en: He was thirty-six sui old.
units.literal: His years were thirty-six.

units.zh: 梁亡。
units.en: The Liang dynasty fell.
units.literal: Liang perished.

units.zh: 四月，莊宗立，稱唐，十月，梁始亡，見唐不待滅梁而立。
units.en: Zhuangzong proclaimed Tang in the fourth month, while Liang did not fall until the tenth; this shows that Tang was founded before Liang was destroyed.
units.literal: In the fourth month, Zhuangzong stood and called the state Tang; in the tenth month, Liang only then perished, showing that Tang did not wait to destroy Liang before standing.

units.zh: 晉王遣都將李嗣昭、李存審、王建及率師來援同州，戰於城下。
units.en: The Prince of Jin sent Li Sizhao, Li Cunshen, and Wang Jianji to relieve Tongzhou and battle was joined under the walls.
units.literal: The Prince of Jin sent commanders Li Sizhao, Li Cunshen, and Wang Jianji with troops to relieve Tongzhou; they fought below the walls.

units.zh: 夏四月己巳，晉王即唐帝位於魏州，改天祐二十年為同光元年。
units.en: On jisi in the fourth month of summer the Prince of Jin took the Tang throne at Weizhou, renaming Tianyou 20 Tongguang 1.
units.literal: On jisi in the fourth month of summer the Prince of Jin assumed the Tang throne at Weizhou, changing Tianyou 20 to Tongguang 1.

units.zh: 時晉王方攻鎮州，故思遠乘虛以襲之，陷成安，而思遠遂急攻德勝北城，晉將李存審極力拒守。
units.en: While the Prince of Jin besieged Zhenzhou, Siyuan took Cheng'an and stormed Desheng’s north wall; Li Cunshen held firm.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Jin was attacking Zhenzhou; hence Siyuan seized the opening to strike, took Cheng'an, and then urgently attacked Desheng’s northern city; Jin commander Li Cunshen resisted with utmost strength.

units.zh: 二月，晉王以兵至，思遠收軍而退，復保楊村。
units.en: In the second month the Prince of Jin came up; Siyuan withdrew to Yang village.
units.literal: In the second month the Prince of Jin arrived with troops; Siyuan gathered the army and withdrew, again holding Yang village.

units.zh: 唐帝棄德勝之北城，並軍保楊劉。
units.en: The Tang emperor abandoned Desheng’s north wall and concentrated at Yangliu.
units.literal: The Tang Emperor abandoned Desheng’s northern city and combined the army to hold Yangliu.

units.zh: 六月乙亥，唐帝引軍援楊劉，潛軍至博州，築壘於河東岸。
units.en: On yihai in the sixth month the Tang emperor relieved Yangliu while secretly fortifying east of Bozhou.
units.literal: On yihai in the sixth month the Tang Emperor led troops to relieve Yangliu, secretly moving the army to Bozhou and building ramparts on the river’s east bank.

units.zh: 秋七月丁未，唐帝引軍沿河而南。
units.en: On dingwei in the seventh month the Tang emperor led his army south along the river.
units.literal: On dingwei in the seventh month of autumn the Tang Emperor led troops south along the river.

units.zh: 庚寅，唐帝軍於胡城，先鋒將康延孝率百騎奔於唐，盡泄其軍機。
units.en: On gengyin at Hucheng vanguard Kang Yanxiao defected with a hundred riders and betrayed Liang dispositions.
units.literal: On gengyin the Tang Emperor’s army was at Hucheng; vanguard commander Kang Yanxiao led a hundred horsemen to defect to Tang and fully revealed our military plans.

units.zh: 甲戌，唐帝引師襲中都，王彥章兵潰，於是彥章與監軍張漢傑及趙廷隱、劉嗣彬、李知節、唐文通、王山興等皆為唐人所獲。
units.en: On jiaxu the Tang emperor stormed Zhongdu; Yanzhang’s army broke; he, Zhang Hanjie, Zhao Tingyin, and others were taken.
units.literal: On jiaxu the Tang Emperor led troops to strike Zhongdu; Wang Yanzhang’s army collapsed; thereupon Yanzhang, army supervisor Zhang Hanjie, Zhao Tingyin, Liu Sibin, Li Zhijie, Tang Wentong, Wang Shanxing, and others were all captured by Tang men.

units.zh: 帝置傳國寶於臥內，俄失其所在，已為左右所竊迎唐帝矣。
units.en: He laid the seal in his chamber; it vanished—courtiers had stolen it to greet the Tang emperor.
units.literal: The Emperor placed the dynastic seal in the sleeping chamber; soon it lost its place—it had already been stolen by attendants to welcome the Tang Emperor.

units.zh: 唐帝入宮，妃郭氏號泣迎拜。
units.en: The Tang emperor entered the palace; Consort Guo wept and bowed in welcome.
units.literal: The Tang Emperor entered the palace; consort Guo wailed and came forward to bow.

units.zh: 唐帝初入東京，聞帝殂，憮然歎曰：「敵惠敵怨，不在後嗣。
units.en: Entering the Eastern Capital, the Tang emperor learned of the Last Emperor’s death and sighed: "Grudges need not pass to sons.
units.literal: When the Tang Emperor first entered the Eastern Capital and heard the Emperor had died, he sighed in dejection: "Enemy kindness and enemy hatred do not lie in later generations.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，以供奉官郎公遠充契丹歡好使。
units.en: On gengyin in the ninth month Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was sent as envoy of goodwill to the Khitan.
units.literal: On gengyin in the ninth month, Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was made Khitan Goodwill envoy.

units.zh: 龍德二年春正月，戴思遠率師襲魏州。
units.en: In the first month of Longde 2 Dai Siyuan raided Weizhou.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of Longde 2, Dai Siyuan led troops to raid Weizhou.

units.zh: 尋詔河南尹張全義收葬之，其首藏於太社。
units.en: He ordered Zhang Quanyi to bury the body; the head was kept at the Grand Altar.
units.literal: Soon an edict ordered Henan Intendant Zhang Quanyi to collect and bury him; his head was stored at the Grand Altar.

units.zh: 先是，繼韜父嗣昭為潞州節度使，戰歿於鎮州城下，晉王欲以嗣昭長子繼儔襲父位。
units.en: His father Li Sizhao had held Luzhou and died at Zhenzhou; the Prince of Jin meant to give the post to eldest son Jichou.
units.literal: Earlier, Jiyao’s father Sizhao was Luzhou military commissioner and fell in battle below Zhenzhou city; the Prince of Jin wished to let Sizhao’s eldest son Jichou succeed his father’s post.

units.zh: 朕與梁主十年對壘，恨不生見其面。」
units.en: We fought ten years; I regret never meeting him alive."
units.literal: I and the Liang ruler faced each other in battle ten years, regretting I did not see his face in life."

units.zh: 冬十月，陳州妖賊毋乙、董乙伏誅。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter the Chenzhou rebels Wu Yi and Dong Yi were put to death.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Chenzhou demonic bandits Wu Yi and Dong Yi were executed.

units.zh: 毋乙數輩，漸及千人，攻掠鄉社，長吏不能詰。
units.en: Wu Yi’s band grew to a thousand, pillaging the countryside while magistrates dared not act.
units.literal: Wu Yi and several companions gradually reached a thousand men, raiding villages and communities; the chief officials could not interrogate them.

units.zh: 群賊乃立毋乙為天子，其餘豪首，各有樹置。
units.en: They proclaimed Wu Yi emperor and installed their other leaders in offices.
units.literal: The bandit host then set up Wu Yi as Son of Heaven; the rest of the chieftains each had appointments made.

units.zh: 至是，發禁軍及數郡兵合勢追擊，賊潰，生擒毋乙等首領八十餘人，械送闕下，並斬於都市。
units.en: Imperial Guards and allied prefectural troops then crushed them, took eighty-odd chiefs including Wu Yi, and beheaded them in the capital market.
units.literal: At this time the court sent the Imperial Guard and troops of several prefectures in combined pursuit; the bandits collapsed, and more than eighty leaders including Wu Yi were captured alive, sent in fetters to the capital, and all beheaded in the marketplace.

units.zh: 陳州裏俗之人，喜習左道，依浮屠氏之教，自立一宗，號曰「上乘」。
units.en: Chenzhou commoners dabbled in heterodox cults, aping Buddhism while founding a sect called the "Supreme Vehicle."
units.literal: The vulgar folk of Chenzhou liked to practice heterodox ways, following the Buddha’s teaching yet establishing a separate sect themselves, called "Supreme Vehicle."

units.zh: 是歲秋，其眾益盛，南通淮夷，朝廷累發州兵討捕，反為賊所敗。
units.en: By autumn they had swelled, linked with Huai tribes, and defeated every prefectural force the court sent.
units.literal: That autumn their masses grew still greater, reaching south to the Huai barbarians; the court repeatedly sent prefectural troops to pursue and capture, yet was in turn defeated by the bandits.

units.zh: 陳、潁、蔡三州，大被其毒。
units.en: Chen, Ying, and Cai bore the worst of their ravages.
units.literal: Chen, Ying, and Cai—the three prefectures—suffered greatly from their poison.

units.zh: 初，樞自歙州罷郡歸朝，路經大梁，時硃全忠兵威已振，樞以兄事之，全忠由是重之。
units.en: Earlier, when Shu returned to court after leaving his prefecture at She, his route passed through Daliang; Zhu Quanzhong's military prestige was already rising, and Shu treated him as an elder brother—whereupon Quanzhong came to esteem him.
units.literal: Earlier, when Shu returned to court after leaving his prefecture at She, his route passed through Daliang; Zhu Quanzhong's military prestige was already rising, and Shu treated him as an elder brother—whereupon Quanzhong came to esteem him.

units.zh: 制出，硃全忠保薦之，言樞有經世才，不可棄之嶺表，尋復拜門下侍郎，監修國史，累兼吏部尚書，判度支。
units.en: The appointment was issued; Zhu Quanzhong petitioned in his support, saying Shu had talent to govern the age and must not be abandoned to the Lingnan frontier—soon Shu was again appointed vice minister of the Chancellery, commissioned to supervise compilation of the dynastic history, and repeatedly served concurrently as minister of personnel, administering the treasury.
units.literal: The appointment was issued; Zhu Quanzhong petitioned in his support, saying Shu had talent to govern the age and must not be abandoned to the Lingnan frontier—soon Shu was again appointed Vice Minister of the Chancellery, commissioned to supervise compilation of the dynastic history, and repeatedly served concurrently as Minister of Personnel, administering the treasury.

units.zh: 及樞傳詔，全忠皆稟朝旨，獻奉相繼，昭宗甚悅，遷兵部侍郎。
units.en: When Shu transmitted the edicts, Quanzhong obeyed the court's intent in all things and sent tribute in succession; Zhaozong was greatly pleased and promoted Shu to vice minister of war.
units.literal: When Shu transmitted the edicts, Quanzhong obeyed the court's intent in all things and sent tribute in succession; Zhaozong was greatly pleased and promoted Shu to Vice Minister of War.

units.zh: 時崔胤專政，亦倚全忠，二人因是相結，改樞吏部侍郎。
units.en: At the time Cui Yin monopolized power and also leaned on Quanzhong; the two therefore formed an alliance, and Shu was changed to vice minister of personnel.
units.literal: At the time Cui Yin monopolized power and also leaned on Quanzhong; the two therefore formed an alliance, and Shu was changed to Vice Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 崔胤誅，以全忠素厚，相位如故。
units.en: After Cui Yin's execution, Shu's ties to Quanzhong kept him in the chancellorship unchanged.
units.literal: When Cui Yin was executed, because of his longstanding closeness to Quanzhong Shu's chancellorship remained unchanged.

units.zh: 壬午，以前蔚州刺史張溫為振武留後，以左右廂突陣指揮使康義誠為汾州刺史，以左右廂馬軍都指揮使索自通為忻州刺史。
units.en: On renwu, Zhang Wen, former prefect of Weizhou, was made acting military commissioner of Zhenwu; Kang Yicheng, commander of the left and right wing assault formations, was made prefect of Fenzhou; and Suo Zitong, cavalry commander-in-chief of the left and right wings, was made prefect of Xinzhou.
units.literal: On renwu, former Weizhou prefect Zhang Wen was made Zhenwu acting military commissioner; left-and-right wing assault-array commander Kang Yicheng was made Fenzhou prefect; left-and-right wing cavalry commander Suo Zitong was made Xinzhou prefect.

units.zh: 太祖遣葛從周、牛存節赴之，逆戰於流河店。
units.en: the Founder sent Ge Congzhou and Niu Cunjie to Liuhe Store.
units.literal: The Founder sent Ge Congzhou and Niu Cunjie to go; they met in battle at Liuhe Store.

units.zh: 次均王友貞，為東都馬步都指揮使。
units.en: Next was Prince of Jun Youzhen, commander of horse and foot at the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: Next was Prince of Jun Youzhen, Eastern Capital Horse and Foot Commander.

units.zh: 遣供奉官丁昭溥馳詣東都，命均王友貞殺友文。
units.en: He sent palace attendant Ding Zhaopu in haste to the Eastern Capital to order Prince of Jun Youzhen to kill Youwen.
units.literal: He dispatched Palace Attendant Ding Zhaopu posthaste to the Eastern Capital ordering Prince of Jun Youzhen to kill Youwen.

units.zh: 梁祖在位止及六年，均帝朝詔史臣修梁祖實錄，岐下系鞋之事，恥而不書。
units.en: Taizu reigned only six years; under Emperor Jun historians were ordered to compile his veritable record—yet the shoe-tying at Qi was too shameful to write.
units.literal: Liang Taizu reigned only six years; in Emperor Jun’s reign an edict ordered historians to compile Taizu’s veritable record—the affair of tying shoes below Qi was shameful and not written.

units.zh: 辛巳，丁昭溥還，聞友文已死，乃發喪，宣遺制，友珪即皇帝位。
units.en: On xinsi Ding Zhaopu returned; learning Youwen was dead, they announced mourning, proclaimed the testament, and Yougui seized the throne.
units.literal: On xinsi Ding Zhaopu returned; hearing Youwen was already dead, they then announced the mourning, proclaimed the testamentary order, and Yougui at once took the throne.

units.zh: 景福初，鎮州王鎔誘河東將李存孝。
units.en: Early in the Jingfu era Wang Rong of Zhenzhou won over the Hedong general Li Cunxiao.
units.literal: At the beginning of the Jingfu reign, Wang Rong of Zhenzhou enticed the Hedong general Li Cunxiao.

units.zh: 時鎔童幼，求援於燕；
units.en: Rong was still young and appealed to Yan for help.
units.literal: At that time Rong was still a child and sought aid from Yan.

units.zh: 鎔以匡威再來援己，致其失師，遣使迎歸府第，父事之。
units.en: Because Kuangwei had twice come to his aid and twice cost him his army, Rong sent envoys to welcome him to his mansion and treated him with the deference due a father.
units.literal: Rong, because Kuangwei had twice come to aid him and thereby caused the loss of his army, sent envoys to welcome him back to the mansion and treated him as a father.

units.zh: 匡威為鎔城郛繕甲，指陳方略，視鎔如子。
units.en: Kuangwei fortified Rong's walls, readied his armor, laid out strategy, and treated Rong as a son.
units.literal: Kuangwei fortified the walls and readied armor for Rong, laid out strategy, and regarded Rong as a son.

units.zh: 會鎔過匡威第慰忌辰，匡威縞衣裹甲，伏兵劫鎔入牙城。
units.en: When Rong came to Kuangwei's mansion to observe a mourning anniversary, Kuangwei wore mourning garments over his armor and used hidden troops to seize Rong and carry him into the headquarters.
units.literal: When Rong happened to visit Kuangwei's mansion to observe a mourning anniversary, Kuangwei wore hemp mourning garments over armor and with hidden troops seized Rong and carried him into the headquarters.

units.zh: 鎔兵逆戰，燔東偏門，軍士呼噪登屋，矢下如雨。
units.en: Rong's troops fought back, burned the eastern gate, and soldiers shouting climbed onto the rooftops as arrows fell like rain.
units.literal: Rong's troops fought back, burned the east side gate, and soldiers shouting climbed onto the roofs; arrows fell like rain.

units.zh: 鎔僕墨君和亂中扶鎔登屋免難，而斬匡威以徇。
units.en: In the chaos Rong's servant Mo Junhe helped him climb onto a roof to safety, then beheaded Kuangwei and displayed his head.
units.literal: Rong's servant Mo Junhe in the chaos helped Rong climb onto a roof and escape harm, then beheaded Kuangwei and displayed the head.

units.zh: 匡威親率軍應之。
units.en: Kuangwei personally led an army to his aid.
units.literal: Kuangwei personally led an army to respond.

units.zh: 二年春，河東復出師井陘，再乞師，匡威來援。
units.en: In the spring of the second year Hedong again marched through Jingxing Pass. Wang Rong again appealed for help, and Kuangwei came to his aid.
units.literal: In spring of the second year Hedong again marched out through Jingxing; Rong again begged for troops, and Kuangwei came to his aid.

units.zh: 鎮之三軍，素忠於王氏，惡其所為。
units.en: The three armies of Zhenzhou had long been loyal to the Wang clan and despised his conduct.
units.literal: The three armies of Zhen had long been loyal to the Wang clan and hated what he was doing.

units.zh: 山南東道節度使楊師厚進納越匡凝東第書籍。
units.en: Yang Shihou of Shannan East surrendered the library of Yue Kuangning's eastern mansion.
units.literal: Yang Shihou, military governor of Shannan East Circuit, presented and surrendered the books of Yue Kuangning's eastern mansion.

units.zh: 先是，收復襄、漢，帝閱其圖書，至是命師厚進焉。
units.en: When Xiangyang and Hanzhong were retaken the Emperor had browsed these books; now he ordered Shihou to deliver them.
units.literal: Earlier, when Xiang and Han were recovered, the Emperor had examined these books; now he ordered Shihou to present them.

units.zh: 二月甲申，晉王攻我黎陽，劉鄩拒之而退。
units.en: On jiashen in the second month, the Prince of Jin attacked Liyang; Liu Xun held him off and forced a withdrawal.
units.literal: On jiashen in the second month, the Prince of Jin attacked our Liyang; Liu Xun resisted him and drove him back.

units.zh: 貞明三年春正月戊午，以前淄州刺史高允奇為右羽林統軍。
units.en: On wuwu in the first month of Zhenming 3, Gao Yunqi, former Inspector of Zi Prefecture, was appointed commander of the Right Feathered Forest.
units.literal: On wuwu, in the first month of spring of Zhenming 3, former Zi Prefecture Inspector Gao Yunqi was made commander of the Right Feathered Forest.

units.zh: 乙酉，立皇兄全昱為廣王，皇子友文為博王，友珪為郢王，友璋為福王，友雍為賀王，友徽為建王。
units.en: On yiyou the Emperor enfeoffed his brother Quanyu as Prince of Guang and his sons Youwen, Yougui, Youzhang, Youyong, and Youhui as Princes of Bo, E, Fu, He, and Jian.
units.literal: On yiyou the Emperor's elder brother Quanyu was established as Prince of Guang, the imperial son Youwen as Prince of Bo, Yougui as Prince of E, Youzhang as Prince of Fu, Youyong as Prince of He, and Youhui as Prince of Jian.

units.zh: 五月，以唐朝宰臣張文蔚、楊涉並為門下侍郎、平章事；
units.en: In the fifth month former Tang chief ministers Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors;
units.literal: In the fifth month, former Tang chief ministers Zhang Wenwei and Yang She were both made Vice Directors of the Secretariat and Grand Councilors;

units.zh: 龍德三年春三月，晉潞州節度留後李繼韜遣使以城歸順。
units.en: In the third month of Longde 3 Li Jiyao of Luzhou offered the city to Liang.
units.literal: In the third month of spring of Longde 3, Jin Luzhou military retention commissioner Li Jiyao sent envoys offering the city in submission.

units.zh: 繼韜在潞州，即執繼儔囚之，遣使來送款，仍以二幼子為質。
units.en: Jiyao imprisoned Jichou, submitted to Liang, and sent two sons as hostages.
units.literal: Jiyao was at Luzhou; he thereupon seized Jichou and imprisoned him, sent envoys to offer allegiance, and also sent two young sons as hostages.

units.zh: 澤州刺史裴約不從繼韜之謀，帝命董璋為澤州刺史，令將兵攻之。
units.en: Ze prefect Pei Yue refused the plot; Dong Zhang was sent to take Ze by force.
units.literal: Ze prefect Pei Yue did not follow Jiyao’s plot; the Emperor ordered Dong Zhang made Ze prefect and commanded him to lead troops to attack.

units.zh: 戊寅，至貝州，命四丞相及學士李琪、盧文度、知制誥竇賞等十五人扈從，其左常侍韋戩等二十三人止焉。
units.en: On wuyin he reached Beizhou and ordered the four chancellors and Academicians Li Qi, Lu Wendu, Drafter Dou Shang, and fifteen others to attend; Left Regular Attendant Wei Zhan and twenty-three others remained behind.
units.literal: On wuyin he reached Beizhou, ordered the four chancellors and Academicians Li Qi, Lu Wendu, Drafter Dou Shang, and fifteen others to attend, while Left Regular Attendant Wei Zhan and twenty-three others remained.

units.zh: 以中書侍郎兼刑部尚書、平章事、集賢殿大學士、判戶部事鄭玨為監修國史、判度支。
units.en: Zheng Jue, Secretariat Vice Minister and Households overseer, took over national history and Revenue.
units.literal: Secretariat Vice Minister concurrent Minister of Punishments, chief minister, Hall of Assembled Worthies grand academician, and Households overseer Zheng Jue was made overseer of national history and Revenue.

units.zh: 宋州刺史王皋進兩岐麥，陳州袁象先進白兔一，付史館編錄，兼示百官。
units.en: Wang Gao of Songzhou offered double-eared wheat; Yuan Xiangxian of Chenzhou a white hare—both were recorded by the Historiography Office and displayed to the court.
units.literal: Wang Gao, prefect of Songzhou, presented double-eared wheat; Yuan Xiangxian of Chenzhou presented one white hare—both were sent to the Historiography Office for record and shown to the hundred officials.

units.zh: 可改唐天祐四年為開平元年，國號大樑。
units.en: Let Tang's Tianyou year 4 become Kaiping year 1; the realm shall be called Great Liang.
units.literal: Let the fourth year of Tang's Tianyou be changed to the first year of Kaiping; the state name is Great Liang.

units.zh: 是月，鎮州大將王德明殺其帥王熔，自稱留後，遣使來求援。
units.en: That month Wang Deming of Zhenzhou murdered Wang Rong, declared himself acting commissioner, and asked for help.
units.literal: That month, Zhenzhou great general Wang Deming killed his commander Wang Rong, styled himself retention commissioner, and sent envoys to seek aid.

units.zh: 宰臣敬翔請許之，租庸使趙岩等以為不可，乃止。
units.en: Jing Xiang favored acceptance; Zhao Yan and others refused, and the court declined.
units.literal: Chief minister Jing Xiang asked to grant it; Rent and Corvée commissioner Zhao Yan and others held it impossible, and it stopped.

units.zh: 時租庸使趙岩勸帝郊天，且言：「帝王受命，須行此禮，願陛下力行之。」
units.en: Rent and Corvée commissioner Zhao Yan urged Heaven-sacrifice, saying: "Emperors who receive the Mandate must perform this rite—Your Majesty should see it through."
units.literal: At the time Rent and Corvée commissioner Zhao Yan urged the Emperor to sacrifice to Heaven, saying: "When emperors receive the Mandate they must perform this rite; Your Majesty should exert yourself to carry it out."

units.zh: 十二月，晉王自太原復至魏州。
units.en: In the twelfth month the Prince of Jin returned from Taiyuan to Weizhou.
units.literal: In the twelfth month the Prince of Jin came again from Taiyuan to Weizhou.

units.zh: 己巳，帝幸洛陽，為來年有事於南郊也。
units.en: On jisi the Emperor went to Luoyang to prepare for a Southern Suburban rite the following year.
units.literal: On jisi the Emperor visited Luoyang, because next year there would be affairs at the Southern Suburban Altar.

units.zh: 時刺史惠王友能恃戚藩之寵，動多不法，故奸慝之徒，望風影附。
units.en: Prefect Prince of Hui You Neng, favored as imperial kin, broke the law at will, and villains flocked to him.
units.literal: At the time the prefect, Prince of Hui You Neng, relied on favor as a maternal kinsman of the imperial clan and often acted unlawfully, so evil men attached to him like shadows in the wind.

units.zh: 夏四月，陳州刺史惠王友能反，舉兵向闕。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer Prince of Hui You Neng of Chenzhou rebelled and marched on the capital.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Chenzhou prefect Prince of Hui You Neng rebelled and raised troops toward the palace.

units.zh: 友能走保陳州，詔張漢傑率兵進討。
units.en: You Neng shut himself in Chenzhou; Zhang Hanjie was ordered to besiege him.
units.literal: You Neng fled to hold Chenzhou; an edict ordered Zhang Hanjie to lead troops forward to attack.

units.zh: 秋七月，陳州朱友能降。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn Zhu You Neng of Chenzhou surrendered.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Chenzhou Zhu You Neng surrendered.

units.zh: 特進、檢校太傅、使持節陳州刺史、兼御史大夫、上柱國、食邑三千戶惠王友能，列爵為王，頒條治郡，受元戎之寄任，處千里之封疆。
units.en: Prince of Hui You Neng of Chen—a prince with three thousand households, entrusted with a thousand li.
units.literal: Specially advanced, honorary Grand Mentor, holding staff as Chenzhou military commissioner, concurrent Censor-in-chief, Pillar of State, fief of three thousand households, Prince of Hui You Neng—enfeoffed prince, issued regulations governing the prefecture, entrusted with the main army’s commission, placed over a thousand-li territory.

units.zh: 可降封房陵侯。
units.en: He is demoted to Marquis of Fangling.
units.literal: He may be demoted and enfeoffed Marquis of Fangling.

units.zh: 其有齒予戚屬，雖深敦敘之情。
units.en: Though kinship binds me to kinsmen,
units.literal: For those who are kin by tooth and gift, though deep is the feeling of kinship and ordering.

units.zh: 伯仲之恩，予垂立愛。
units.en: yet as brother I still show love.
units.literal: in elder and younger brother’s grace, I still set up love.

units.zh: 而狎彼小人，納其邪說，忽稱兵而向闕，敢越境以殘民，侵犯郊畿，驚撓輦轂，遠邇咸嫉，謀畫交陳。
units.en: Instead he listened to villains, marched on the capital, ravaged the people, and terrified the court.
units.literal: Yet he fraternized with petty men and took in their evil counsel; suddenly he called up troops toward the palace, dared cross borders to harm the people, invaded the suburbs, alarmed the imperial carriage—near and far alike resented it, plans and memorials piled up.

units.zh: 顧茲輕典，豈稱群情，凡在臣僚，當體朕意。」
units.en: This light sentence may not satisfy opinion; officials should understand my intent."
units.literal: Looking upon this light code, how can it match the crowd’s feeling—every official should embody my intent."

units.zh: 帝命將出師逆擊，敗之。
units.en: The Emperor sent armies to meet them and won.
units.literal: The Emperor ordered generals to take the field and strike in reverse, defeating them.

units.zh: 庚子，詔曰：「朕君臨四海，子育兆民，惟持不黨之心，庶葉無私之運。
units.en: On gengzi the Emperor declared: "I rule all and seek impartial justice.
units.literal: On gengzi, an edict said: "I rule the four seas and nurture the hundred millions, holding only an unbiased heart, hoping to fulfill an unselfish destiny.

units.zh: 幹我國經，難固含宏之旨。
units.en: those who break the law cannot be indulged.
units.literal: if they disturb our state’s laws, it is hard to fix the intent of forbearance.

units.zh: 須遵常憲，以示至公。
units.en: Statute must prevail over favor.
units.literal: They must follow the regular statutes to show utmost fairness.

units.zh: 就進官資，巳登崇貴，時加錫賚，以表優隆。
units.en: He had been raised to the highest honors and showered with gifts.
units.literal: Upon advancing in office and rank he already ascended to lofty honor; from time to time gifts were added to show special elevation.

units.zh: 宜切知恩，合思盡節，撫俗當申於仁政，佐時期效於忠規。
units.en: He should have repaid favor with loyalty and governed humanely.
units.literal: He ought deeply to know grace and think to exhaust loyalty, soothing the folk with humane government and in assisting the age expecting to effect loyal counsel.

units.zh: 及興問罪之師，旋驗知非之狀，瀝懇繼陳於章表，束身願赴於闕庭，備述艱危，覬加寬恕。
units.en: Defeated, he begged forgiveness and offered to surrender at court.
units.literal: When troops to question his crime were raised, he soon proved knowledge of wrong in his conduct; earnest pleas followed in memorials, binding himself willing to come to the palace court, fully narrating peril, hoping for added forgiveness.

units.zh: 朕得不自為屈己，姑務安仁，特施貸法之恩，蓋舉議親之律。
units.en: I humbled myself and showed kin mercy under commuted sentence.
units.literal: I could not but humble myself and for the moment seek to settle benevolence, specially applying the grace of commuted law, broadly raising the statute of favoring kin.

units.zh: 詢於事體，抑有朝章，止行退責之文，用塞眾多之論。
units.en: Yet statute required punishment; demotion alone answers the critics.
units.literal: Inquiring into the matter’s substance, there is still court statute; only the writing of demotion is executed to block the many discussions.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Ah!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 君臣之禮，彼有不恭；
units.en: Between ruler and subject he showed no respect;
units.literal: In the rite of ruler and minister, he was not respectful;

units.zh: 冬十月，北面招討使戴思遠攻德勝寨之北城，晉人來援，思遠敗於戚城。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Dai Siyuan attacked Desheng’s north wall; Jin relief defeated him at Qi.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Northern Pacification commissioner Dai Siyuan attacked the northern city of Desheng Stockade; Jin men came to relieve; Siyuan was defeated at Qi city.

units.zh: 戴思遠又下淇門、共城、新鄉等三縣。
units.en: Dai Siyuan also seized Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.
units.literal: Dai Siyuan also took the three counties of Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.

units.zh: 二月，遣將謝彥章帥眾數萬迫楊劉城。
units.en: In the second month General Xie Yanzhang marched tens of thousands against Yangliu.
units.literal: In the second month the general Xie Yanzhang led tens of thousands to press Yangliu city.

units.zh: 甲子，晉王來援楊劉城，彥章之軍不利而退。
units.en: On jiazi the Prince of Jin relieved Yangliu; Yanzhang's force was beaten and fell back.
units.literal: On jiazi the Prince of Jin came to relieve Yangliu; Yanzhang's army met ill fortune and withdrew.

units.zh: 貞明四年春正月，晉人寇鄆、濮之境，車駕至自洛陽。
units.en: In the first month of Zhenming 4, Jin forces raided Yan and Pu; the Emperor returned from Luoyang.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of Zhenming 4, Jin men raided the borders of Yan and Pu; the imperial carriage returned from Luoyang.

units.zh: 是月，命開封尹王瓚為北面行營招討使。
units.en: That month Wang Zan, Kaifeng prefect, was named Northern Line pacification commissioner.
units.literal: That month Kaifeng prefect Wang Zan was made Northern Line camp pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 瓚乃與許州留後王彥章等率大軍自黎陽濟，營於楊村，造浮梁以通津路。
units.en: Zan crossed from Liyang with Wang Yanzhang of Xu, camped at Yang village, and bridged the ford.
units.literal: Zan then with Xu retention commissioner Wang Yanzhang and others led a great army across from Liyang, encamped at Yang village, and built a floating bridge to open the crossing.

units.zh: 辛卯，王瓚帥師至戚城，遇晉軍。
units.en: On xinmao, Wang Zan marched to Qi city and encountered the Jin.
units.literal: On xinmao, Wang Zan led troops to Qi city and met Jin troops.

units.zh: 十二月戊戌，晉王領軍迫河南寨，王瓚率師禦之，獲晉將石家才。
units.en: On wuxu in the twelfth month the Prince of Jin pressed the Henan stockade; Wang Zan held him off and took the Jin general Shi Jiacai.
units.literal: On wuxu in the twelfth month, the Prince of Jin led troops to press the Henan stockade; Wang Zan led troops to resist and captured Jin general Shi Jiacai.

units.zh: 既而瓚軍不利，瓚退保楊村寨，晉人陷濮陽。
units.en: Soon Zan was beaten back to Yang village; the Jin seized Puyang.
units.literal: Before long Zan's army met ill fortune; Zan withdrew to defend Yang village stockade, and the Jin took Puyang.

units.zh: 交綏而退。
units.en: After a brief clash both sides drew off.
units.literal: They crossed arms and withdrew.

units.zh: 六月，遣兗州節度使劉鄩、華州節度使尹皓、崇州節度使溫昭圖、莊宅使段凝領軍攻同州。
units.en: In the sixth month Liu Yan of Yan, Yin Hao of Hua, Wen Zhaotu of Chong, and Duan Ning of the Manor Estates marched on Tongzhou.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Yanzhou military commissioner Liu Yan, Huazhou military commissioner Yin Hao, Chongzhou military commissioner Wen Zhaotu, and Manor Estates commissioner Duan Ning led armies to attack Tongzhou.

units.zh: 八月，段凝、張朗攻衛州，下之，獲刺史李存儒以獻。
units.en: In the eighth month Duan Ning and Zhang Lang took Weizhou and sent captive commissioner Li Cunru to court.
units.literal: In the eighth month Duan Ning and Zhang Lang attacked Weizhou and took it, capturing military commissioner Li Cunru and presenting him.

units.zh: 己巳，王彥章、段凝圍楊劉城。
units.en: On jisi Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning besieged Yangliu.
units.literal: On jisi, Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning besieged Yangliu city.

units.zh: 八月，以段凝代王彥章為北面行營招討使。
units.en: In the eighth month Duan Ning replaced Wang Yanzhang as northern commander.
units.literal: In the eighth month Duan Ning replaced Wang Yanzhang as Northern Campaign Pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 戊子，段凝營於王村，引軍自高陵渡河，復臨河而還。
units.en: On wuzi Duan Ning camped at Wang village, crossed at Gaoling, and maneuvered along the river.
units.literal: On wuzi, Duan Ning encamped at Wang village, led troops from Gaoling to cross the river, and again faced the river returning.

units.zh: 帝聞中都之敗，唐軍長驅將至，遣張漢倫馳驛召段凝於河上；
units.en: Hearing of Zhongdu’s fall and Tang’s advance, the Emperor dispatched Zhang Hanlun to recall Duan Ning from the river;
units.literal: The Emperor heard of Zhongdu’s defeat and that Tang troops were coming at speed; he sent Zhang Hanlun by post relay to summon Duan Ning on the river;

units.zh: 時禁軍尚有四千人，朱圭請以拒唐軍，帝不從，登建國門召開封尹王瓚，謂之曰：「段凝未至，社稷係卿方略。」
units.en: Four thousand guards remained; Zhu Gui begged to fight; the Emperor refused, climbed the Founding Gate, called Wang Zan, and said: "Until Duan Ning comes the realm rests on you."
units.literal: At the time the Imperial Guard still had four thousand men; Zhu Gui asked to use them to resist Tang troops; the Emperor did not follow, ascended the Founding Gate, summoned Kaifeng Intendant Wang Zan, and said to him: "Duan Ning has not arrived—the altars depend on your strategy."

units.zh: 己卯，以宣義軍節度副大使、知節度事、北面行營副招討等使、特進、檢校太傅霍彥威為天平軍節度副大使，知節度事。
units.en: On jimao, Huo Yanwei—deputy commissioner of Xuanyi, acting military commissioner, deputy northern pacification commissioner, specially advanced, and honorary Grand Mentor—was named deputy commissioner of Tianping with charge of military affairs.
units.literal: On jimao, Xuanyi Army deputy commissioner, acting military commissioner, Northern Line deputy pacification commissioner, specially advanced, honorary Grand Mentor Huo Yanwei was made Tianping Army deputy commissioner, acting military commissioner.

units.zh: 初，學士竇夢征草錢鏐麻，貶蓬萊尉，帝召專入翰林，遣崇政使李振問宰相云：「專是宰臣蕭頃女婿，令中書商量可否？」
units.en: Earlier, Dou Mengzheng had drafted Qian Liu's edict and was banished to Penglai; the Emperor now summoned Zhuan to the Hanlin and sent Li Zhen to ask: "Zhuan is Xiao Qing's son-in-law—should the Secretariat weigh this?"
units.literal: Earlier, academician Dou Mengzheng had drafted Qian Liu's appointment edict and was demoted to subprefect of Penglai; the Emperor summoned Zhuan into the Hanlin and sent Chongzheng commissioner Li Zhen to ask the chancellors: "Zhuan is Chancellor Xiao Qing's son-in-law—should the Secretariat discuss whether this is permissible?"

units.zh: 夏四月丁未，以宣徽院使、右衛上將軍趙縠權知青州軍州事，以宣徽院副使韋堅權知本院事。
units.en: On dingwei in the fourth month of summer, Zhao Gu, Xuanhui Court commissioner and Right Guard senior general, was made acting commissioner for Qingzhou's military and prefectural affairs; Xuanhui Court deputy commissioner Wei Jian was made acting head of that court.
units.literal: On dingwei in the fourth month of summer, Xuanhui Court commissioner and Right Guard senior general Zhao Gu was made acting Qing prefect military and prefectural commissioner; Xuanhui Court deputy commissioner Wei Jian was made acting head of that court.

units.zh: 甲寅，以刑部郎中、充史館修撰竇專為翰林學士。
units.en: On jiayin, Dou Zhuan, Ministry of Punishments director and History Office compiler, entered the Hanlin Academy.
units.literal: On jiayin, Ministry of Punishments bureau director and History Office compiler Dou Zhuan was made Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 攝侍中楊涉為押傳國寶使，翰林院學士張策副之；
units.en: Acting Shizhong Yang She was made chief custodian of the imperial seal, with Hanlin Academician Zhang Ce as deputy;
units.literal: Acting Shizhong Yang She was made chief custodian of the dynastic seal, with Hanlin Academician Zhang Ce as deputy;

units.zh: 甲子，張文蔚、楊涉乘輅自上源驛至，從冊寶諸司各備儀衛鹵簿前導，百官從其後，至金祥殿前陳之。
units.en: On jiazi Zhang Wenwei and Yang She came in the imperial carriage from Shangyuan Post, regalia and seals borne ahead with full guard, officials following, and arrayed all before the Hall of Golden Auspice.
units.literal: On jiazi, Zhang Wenwei and Yang She rode the imperial carriage from Shangyuan Post; the offices bearing registers and seals each prepared guards and insignia to go before, the hundred officials following behind, until they arrayed them before the Hall of Golden Auspice.

units.zh: 張文蔚、蘇循奉冊升殿進讀，楊涉、張策、薛貽矩、趙光逢以次奉寶升殿，讀已，降，帥百官舞蹈稱駕。
units.en: Zhang Wenwei and Su Xun presented and read the register; Yang She, Zhang Ce, Xue Yiju, and Zhao Guangfeng presented the seals in turn; then they led the court in the bowing dance and acclamation.
units.literal: Zhang Wenwei and Su Xun bore the register up the hall and read it; Yang She, Zhang Ce, Xue Yiju, and Zhao Guangfeng in turn bore the seals up the hall; when the reading was done they descended and led the hundred officials in ritual dance and acclamation.

units.zh: 《通鑒》：甲辰，唐昭宣帝降御劄禪位於梁。
units.en: The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 notes: On jiachen Emperor Zhaoxuan of Tang issued an imperial decree abdicating to Liang.
units.literal: The 《Zizhi Tongjian》 says: On jiachen, Tang's Emperor Zhaoxuan issued an imperial decree abdicating the throne to Liang.

units.zh: 十月，帝以用軍，未暇西幸，文武百官等久居東京，漸及疑訝，令就便各許歸安，只留韓建、薛貽矩，翰林學士張策、韋郊、杜曉，中書舍人封舜聊、張袞並左右御史、司天監、宗正寺，兼要當諸司節級外，其宰臣張文蔚已下文武百官，並先於西京祗候。
units.en: In the tenth month, busy with war and unable to go west, the Emperor let officials long in the Eastern Capital return home on leave, keeping only Han Jian, Xue Yiju, Zhang Ce, Wei Jiao, Du Xiao, Feng Shunliao, Zhang Gun, censors, the astronomical directorate, and the imperial clan office—while Zhang Wenwei and the rest were to wait at the Western Capital.
units.literal: In the tenth month, because the Emperor was using the army and had no leisure to visit the west, civil and military officials long dwelling in the Eastern Capital gradually grew doubtful; he ordered that each might return home as convenient, retaining only Han Jian, Xue Yiju, Hanlin academicians Zhang Ce, Wei Jiao, and Du Xiao, Secretariat drafters Feng Shunliao and Zhang Gun, and the Left and Right Censors, Directorate of Astronomy, and Court of Imperial Clan, together with essential bureau chiefs—while chief ministers from Zhang Wenwei down and all civil and military officials should first wait in attendance at the Western Capital.

units.zh: 壬午，保義軍節度使朱友謙進百官衣二百副。
units.en: On renwu Zhu Youqian of the Baoyi Army offered two hundred sets of court robes.
units.literal: On renwu, Zhu Youqian, military governor of the Baoyi Army, presented two hundred sets of official robes.
